summary: Higher-level NC3/NLCC governance includes controlled or currently unrecovered directives whose public titles/placeholders can be mapped but whose governing contents are not available in the public BlackIndex corpus.

stated_reason_missing: Controlled directives are not authorized for public posting, or a first-party public artifact has not been recovered. This is an access/provenance state, not evidence that the records do not exist.
potential_relevance: Defines the higher-level governance, responsibilities, configuration, safety/security, and enterprise relationships that public platform manuals and public NC3 policy layers reference.
